text: Ereyga “buug” wadarkiisu waa “buugag”. Sidaas oo kale, “dal” wadarkiisu waa maxay?
gloss: The plural of "buug" (book) is "buugag". Likewise, the plural of "dal" (country)? — Dalal: one-syllable masculine nouns repeat their last consonant + a ("dalalka" = the countries). "Dalaal" is a different word (broker).

text: “Hooyo” marka la qeexo waxay noqotaa “hooyada”. Ereyga “aabbe” se maxuu noqdaa?
gloss: "Mother" with the article becomes "hooyada". And "aabbe" (father)? — Aabbaha: masculine nouns in -e take -aha; -da is feminine.

text: Ereyga “qorraxdhac” wuxuu ka samaysan yahay “qorrax” iyo “dhac”. Waa xilligee maalinta?
gloss: The word "qorraxdhac" is built from "sun" and "fall". Which time of day? — Evening: it means sunset.

text: Ereyga “toddobaad” wuxuu ka dhashay tirada “toddoba”. Hadalka caadiga ah, waa muddo intee le'eg?
gloss: "Toddobaad" comes from "toddoba" (seven). In everyday speech, how long is it? — Seven days: "toddobaad" is the week.

text: “Dayax-gacmeed” waa dayax gacan lagu sameeyay oo dhulka ku wareega. Waa maxay?
gloss: "Dayax-gacmeed" is a hand-made moon circling the Earth. What is it? — A satellite: dayax = moon, gacmeed = made by hand. The rocket only carries it up.

text: Rootiga khafiifka ah ee quraacda, ee dhinac keliya la dubo oo dushiisa godad yaryar leeyahay, waa kee?
gloss: The thin breakfast bread cooked on one side only, with small holes on top? — Canjeero (laxoox). Sabaayad and kimis are flat breads without holes; muufo is thick and baked.

text: Guriga reer-guuraaga ee la furfuro, geel lagu raro, meel kalena lagu dhiso, waa kee?
gloss: The nomad home that is taken apart, loaded on camels and rebuilt elsewhere? — The aqal. A mundul is a fixed round hut, a cariish a rectangular hut, a daar a stone house.

text: Dekedaha Berbera iyo Boosaaso waxay ku yaalliin xeebta badda la yidhaahdo?
gloss: Berbera and Bosaso ports lie on which sea? — The Gulf of Aden.

text: Sida maahmaahdu tidhaahdo, ninkii aan dhul marin maxaa ka maqan?
gloss: As the proverb says, what does a man who has not travelled lack? — Eyes: «Nin aan dhul marin dhaayo ma leh» (travel opens your eyes).

text: Orodyahanka reer Ingiriis ee asalkiisu Soomaaliga yahay, ee Olombikada 2012 iyo 2016 qaaday afar bilood dahab ah?
gloss: The British runner of Somali origin who won four Olympic golds in 2012 and 2016? — Mo Farah (5,000 m and 10,000 m at both Games).

text: Macmacaanka dhegdhegga ah ee aroosyada iyo ciidaha lagu martiyo, ee sonkor iyo subag laga sameeyo?
gloss: The sticky sweet served at weddings and Eid, made from sugar and ghee? — Xalwo (halwa).

text: Geela, dhaddigga waxaa la yidhaahdaa “hal”. Labka rarka iyo aqalka qaada se?
gloss: A female camel is "hal". And the male that carries the loads and the hut? — Awr, the pack camel. Qaalin is a young female, nirig a calf, baarqab the breeding bull.

text: Sheekooyinka Giriigga, yaa ku duulay baalal shamac lagu dhejiyay, qorraxda u dhowaaday, kadibna dhacay?
gloss: In Greek myth, who flew on wings stuck with wax, came too close to the sun and fell? — Icarus.

text: Afarta xilli — Jiilaal, Gu', Xagaa iyo Dayr — midkee ayaa ah xilliga roobka ugu badan?
gloss: Of the four Somali seasons, which brings the most rain? — Gu' (April–June), the main rainy season; Dayr is the shorter one, Jiilaal the harsh dry season.

text: Ciwaanka bogga internetka marka uu ku bilowdo “https” oo qufulka yar muuqdo, maxaa la ogaanayaa?
gloss: When a web address starts with "https" and the small padlock shows, what do you know? — The connection is encrypted.

text: Kombiyuutarka Windows-ka, “Ctrl + Z” maxay qabataa?
gloss: On a Windows computer, what does Ctrl+Z do? — Undo the last action.

text: Kubadda cagta, “VAR” maxaa loo adeegsadaa?
options: Waqti dheeraad ah ayaa lagu daraa
Garsooruhu muuqaal dib ayuu u eegaa
gloss: In football, what is VAR used for? — Video review of incidents for the referee.

text: Kareemka qorraxda ee “SPF” ku qoran yahay, maqaarka wuxuu ka ilaaliyaa?
gloss: Sun cream marked "SPF" protects the skin from? — Ultraviolet rays.

text: Baakadaha qaar waxaa ku sawiran saddex fallaadhood oo wareeg samaynaya. Maxay ka dhigan tahay?
gloss: Some packaging shows three arrows in a loop. What does it mean? — It can be recycled.

text: Ciyaarta Ludo, xabbadda si gurigeeda looga soo saaro, laadhuugu inta badan muxuu keenaa?
gloss: In Ludo, what must the die usually show to bring a piece out of its home? — Six.

text: Cuntada qaboojiyaha la geliyo maxay u waartaa muddo dheer?
gloss: Why does food last longer in the fridge? — Cold slows the growth of germs.

text: App-ka “Shazam” maxaa inta badan loo isticmaalaa?
gloss: What is the Shazam app mostly used for? — Identifying the song that is playing.

text: Bogagga internetka, qaybta lagu magacaabo “FAQ” maxaa ku jira?
options: Su'aalaha inta badan la is weydiiyo
gloss: On websites, what is in the section called 'FAQ'? — Frequently asked questions, with their answers.

text: Daawooyinka antibiyootigu waxay daaweeyaan cudurrada ay keenaan?
gloss: Antibiotics treat illnesses caused by? — Bacteria; they do nothing against viruses such as the common cold.

text: Qaxwaha “decaf” ah, maxaa inta badan laga saaray?
gloss: What has been taken out of "decaf" coffee? — Caffeine.

text: Fooxa (beeyada) ee laga dhoofiyo buuraha Sanaag iyo Bari, waa qaybtee geedka?
gloss: Frankincense (foox/beeyo) exported from the Sanaag and Bari mountains is which part of the tree? — The resin that seeps from cuts in the trunk of the Boswellia tree.

text: Dukaan albaabkiisa waxaa ku qoran “24/7”. Goormuu xidhan yahay?
gloss: A shop door says "24/7". When is it closed? — Never: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

text: Marka taleefanka la geliyo “Airplane mode”, maxaa la damiyaa?
gloss: Turning on 'Airplane mode' switches off what? — The phone's network connections: mobile signal, and by default Wi-Fi and Bluetooth.

text: Qalabka muusigga ee “kaban”, oo fanka Soomaalida qarnigii 20aad hormuud u ahaa, waa nooc ka mid ah?
gloss: The "kaban", lead instrument of 20th-century Somali music, is a kind of? — Oud (a lute).

text: Abwaanka Maxamed Ibraahim Warsame waxaa loogu yeedhaa naanaysta?
gloss: Poet Maxamed Ibraahim Warsame is known by which nickname? — Hadraawi. Gaarriye was Maxamed Xaashi Dhamac, Timacadde was Cabdullaahi Suldaan.

text: Filimka “The Lion King”, oraahda “Hakuna Matata” waa luqaddee?
gloss: In "The Lion King", "Hakuna Matata" is in which language? — Swahili ("no worries").

text: Suushiga Jabbaan waxaa inta badan lagu sameeyaa bariis iyo maxay?
gloss: Japanese sushi is mostly made of rice and what? — Raw fish.

text: Kanaalka Suweys wuxuu Badda Cas ku xidhaa badda kale?
gloss: The Suez Canal links the Red Sea to which other sea? — The Mediterranean.

text: Koob biyo baraf leh dibaddiisa dhibco biyo ah ayaa ka soo baxa. Xaggee ka yimaadeen?
gloss: Drops of water form on the outside of a glass of ice water. Where do they come from? — Water vapour in the air, condensing on the cold surface; the glass does not leak.

text: Masku carrabkiisa laba-fargoodka ah wuu soo saaraa oo celiyaa. Maxay u tahay?
gloss: A snake flicks its forked tongue in and out. Why? — To smell: it picks up scent particles and carries them to an organ in its mouth.

text: Jilaaga Ingiriiska ah ee Mr. Bean ku jila, isagoo hadal yar ku qosliya, waa kuma?
gloss: The English actor who plays Mr. Bean, getting laughs with few words? — Rowan Atkinson. Chaplin is the silent-film trap.

text: Ereyga “inan” wuxuu noqon karaa lab ama dhaddig. “Inanta” kee ayay tilmaamaysaa?
gloss: "Inan" can be male or female. Who does "inanta" mean? — A girl: the article -ta is feminine; a boy is "inanka".

text: Magaalada qadiimiga ah ee xeebta ku taal, uguna dhow xadka Jabuuti, waa?
gloss: The ancient coastal town closest to the Djibouti border? — Zeila (Saylac).

text: Tartanka orodka ee 4 × 100 mitir, ciyaartoyda kooxdu maxay isu dhiibaan?
gloss: In the 4×100 m relay, what do teammates hand to each other? — A baton. The torch is the Olympic-flame trap.

text: Lambarka IMEI ee *#06# lagu arko, maxuu aqoonsadaa?
gloss: The IMEI number shown by *#06# identifies what? — The phone handset itself, not the SIM card.

text: “Waddada Xariirta” magaceeda waxaa laga bixiyay alaab laga keeni jiray dalkee?
gloss: The "Silk Road" is named after goods brought from which country? — China, where silk was made.

text: Magaalada qadiimiga ah ee Petra, ee Urdun, dhismayaasheeda caanka ah sidee loo sameeyay?
gloss: How were the famous buildings of ancient Petra in Jordan made? — Carved into the rock of the cliffs.

text: Qiimaha shay 50% ayaa laga dhimay, kadibna qiimaha cusub mar kale 50%. Guud ahaan intee laga dhimay?
gloss: A price is cut by 50%, then the new price by 50% again. What is the total cut? — 75%: half of a half is a quarter, so a quarter of the price is left. 100% is the autopilot answer.

text: Sheeko-faneedka caanka ah ee “Things Fall Apart” waxaa qoray?
gloss: Who wrote the novel "Things Fall Apart"? — Chinua Achebe (Nigeria, 1958). Soyinka is the other Nigerian giant; Nuruddin Farah the Somali trap.

text: Libaax-badeedka qalfoofkiisu maaha laf sida kalluunka badankiisa. Wuxuu ka samaysan yahay?
gloss: A shark's skeleton is not bone like most fish. What is it made of? — Cartilage.

text: Afarta tartan ee waaweyn ee tennis-ka, kee ayaa lagu ciyaaraa garoon dhoobo casaan ah?
gloss: Of tennis's four Grand Slams, which is played on red clay? — Roland-Garros (French Open). Wimbledon is grass, the other two hard courts.

text: Dalalka dhul-weynaha Afrika, kee ayaa leh xeebta ugu dheer?
gloss: Of the countries of mainland Africa, which has the longest coastline? — Somalia, about 3,300 km. "Mainland" excludes Madagascar.

text: Shaaha cagaaran iyo shaaha madow, maxaa ugu weyn ee kala duwa?
options: Geedo kala duwan ayay ka yimaadaan
gloss: What mainly separates green tea from black tea? — Processing: both come from the same plant, Camellia sinensis; black tea leaves are left to oxidise, green tea leaves are heated to stop it.

text: Shimbiris, barta ugu sarraysa Soomaaliya, waxay ku taal silsiladda buuraha?
gloss: Shimbiris, Somalia's highest point, lies in which mountain range? — Cal Madow, in Sanaag (about 2,416 m).

text: Sahamiyihii Ingiriiska ahaa ee 1855-kii galay Harar, kadibna qoray “First Footsteps in East Africa”?
gloss: The British explorer who entered Harar in 1855 and then wrote "First Footsteps in East Africa"? — Richard Burton, travelling from Zeila through Somali country. Speke was on the same expedition but did not go to Harar.
